en.name: Ham deli meat, pre-packaged
en.summary: A sealed pack of pre-packaged sliced ham keeps 2 weeks from purchase in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened. Freezing is not recommended for quality, although an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Sliced deli ham does not belong at room temperature. It is cooked, moist, low in acid and eaten without any further cooking, which is the profile most associated with Listeria — and Listeria grows slowly even at fridge temperature, which is exactly why the opened window is so much shorter than the sealed one. Keep it cold on the way home. Out of the fridge it gets two hours at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F); a sandwich platter standing on a table through an afternoon is the situation to avoid.
en.fridge: Unopened, 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; once opened, 3–5 days. Keep it on a cold shelf rather than in the door, wrapped airtight or in a sealed box so the slices do not dry and grey at the edges, and store it away from raw meat. People who are pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised are usually advised either to avoid ready-to-eat deli meats or to heat them until steaming hot first — non-dried deli meats such as cooked ham are specifically named in that advice, whereas dried and salted products are treated as the safer choice.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended. Thin slices of cured, brine-injected ham release water on thawing and come back wet and soft, with a saltier, slightly metallic edge, and they tear when you try to separate them. If you freeze it anyway, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze well inside the fridge window, lay the pack flat, and use the thawed slices in a cooked dish rather than in a sandwich.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and use within the opened window. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices — the earliest reliable sign.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell when the pack is opened.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dried dark edges.
A puffed pack, or cloudy ropy liquid inside it.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack; the sealed figure does not carry over.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Take out what you need and reseal rather than leaving the pack open.
Heat until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does packaged sliced ham keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the slices come back wet and soft. If you do, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C.

faq.q: Is deli ham safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Non-dried deli meats such as cooked ham are on the list to avoid, because of Listeria. Heating them until steaming hot first is the usual advice if you want to eat them.

zh.name: 包裝火腿切片
zh.summary: 未開封的包裝火腿切片，自購買日起放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。基於品質並不建議冷凍，但未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 即食火腿片不屬於室溫。它是煮熟、含水、低酸性，而且不會再加熱就被吃掉，這正是最常與李斯特菌連結的型態——而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會緩慢生長，這也正是開封後期限比未開封短這麼多的原因。買回家的路上要保冷。離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時；三明治拼盤在桌上放一整個下午，就是要避免的情況。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封後 3～5 天。請放冷藏層架而不是門邊，密封包好或裝密閉盒避免肉片邊緣乾掉發灰，並與生肉分開存放。懷孕、年長或免疫功能低下者，通常會被建議避開即食熟肉，或先加熱到冒蒸氣再吃——像熟火腿這類「非乾式」的熟肉是被點名的對象，而乾式鹽漬的產品則被視為相對安全的選擇。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍。注過鹽水的醃製火腿薄片解凍後會出水，回來時濕軟、鹹味更重、還帶一點金屬味，而且一撕就破。真要冷凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。請在冷藏期限還很充裕時就冷凍、包裝平放，並且把解凍後的肉片用在加熱料理上，不要拿來夾三明治。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，並在開封後的期限內用完。不要放室溫退冰，也不要二次冷凍。
spoilage: 肉片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜——最早也最可靠的徵兆。
拆封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣乾黑。
包裝鼓脹，或裡面的汁液變混濁牽絲。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期，未開封的數字不能延用。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放門邊。
要用多少拿多少再封回去，不要整包開著。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 包裝火腿片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起冷藏 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，解凍後會濕軟。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃即食火腿嗎？
faq.a: 熟火腿這類非乾式熟肉因李斯特菌風險被列入建議避免的清單。若要吃，通常建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
